title: Immutability Helper

examples.explanation: Two edits were made to the original array. The first element in the array was to set 5. Then a new key was added with a value of 7.
The values of "x" and "y" were swapped.

constraints: mutators is an array of functions
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Immutability Helper.
